# Silent Peak Kudremukh Homestay

## About
Silent Peak Kudremukh Homestay is a premium mountain retreat in the lush green hills of Kudremukh, Karnataka, India. Located in Hosmata, Samse, near Kudremukh National Park. We offer a peaceful escape with stunning mountain views, home-cooked Malnad cuisine, and genuine hospitality.

## Services
- Homestay accommodation with mountain views (15-20 guests capacity)
- Home-cooked Malnad cuisine
- Trekking (Kudremukh Peak, Kurinjal, Netravati, Gangadikal)
- Jeep safari
- Camping and campfire
- Nature walks and bird watching
- Photography tours

## Pricing
- ₹1,500 per person per night (negotiable)
- Food included

## Booking
Bookings are made via phone call, WhatsApp, or the contact form on the website. No online payment system.

## Location
Hosmata, Samse, Kudremukh, Kalasa, Chikkamagaluru district, Karnataka, India. Near Kudremukh National Park. Best homestay in Chikkamagaluru.
